gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

Current wording in the PR description: "Compare signatures in constant time."
Proposed wording: the sentence is removed, which drops the requirement.

Today the PR promises that signatures are checked in a way that takes the same time whether or not they match, so an attacker cannot guess a valid signature by timing the rejections. Dropping that promise would make bringing the branch up to date with main easier, but the PR's goal of rejecting forged events would become weaker. I recommend preserve contract, because nothing shows that the changes on main cannot be combined with the constant-time check.

Pick one:
1. preserve contract - keep the constant-time promise, set this proposal aside, and resume delivery by rebasing on main again without dropping it. [recommended]
2. accept contract change - remove the constant-time promise from the PR description, then resume delivery with an ordinary comparison.
3. stop - leave the PR as it is and remove the local checkout.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

I recommend preserving the contract because the conflict report does not establish why unsigned-event rejection cannot be delivered while keeping the timing protection.

2. accept contract change - invoke the scope-amendment process to drop constant-time comparison, then resume delivery only after the amendment completes.
3. stop - end this run without changing the requirement or posting anything; remove the eligible worktree while preserving any unpushed commits.
